title: Reported questions, orders, requests
subtitle: Reporting what someone asked, ordered or requested

blocks.text: We use reported questions, orders and requests to report what someone else asked, ordered or requested. We do not use question word order in reported questions.

rows.use: questions beginning with have, do or be
rows.example: 'Have you been to the gallery?' he asked her. → He asked her **if she had been** to the gallery. 'Are you making a skirt?' I asked Anne. → I asked Anne **if she was making** a skirt.

'Can you paint?' Mary asked her friend. → Mary asked her friend **if she could** paint. 'Will you make me one?' I asked Terry. → I asked Terry **if he would** make me one. 'Shall I wear a jacket?' I asked Mum. → I asked Mum **if I should** wear a jacket. 'May I borrow your coat?' Mr Jones asked me. → Mr Jones asked me **if he might** borrow my coat.

rows.use: questions beginning with a question word
rows.example: 'What kind of shoes are in fashion now?' my mum asked me. → My mum asked me **what kind of shoes were** in fashion at that moment. 'Who did you see at the fashion show?' asked Ben. → Ben asked **who I had seen** at the fashion show. 'Which one do you want?' Sarah asked Liam. → Sarah asked Liam **which one he wanted**. 'When will they finish the house?' I asked. → I asked **when they would** finish the house. 'Why did you say that?' my sister asked me. → My sister asked me **why I had said** that. 'How much did your hat cost?' Ed asked Carl. → Ed asked Carl **how much his hat had cost**.
'Put your clothes in the drawer,' Mum said. → Mum **told me to put** my clothes in the drawer. 'Don't wear the red one,' Alice said. → Alice **told me not to wear** the red one.
'Will you make me one?' I asked Terry. → I **asked Terry to make** me one. 'Please don't move my pictures,' said Olga. → Olga **asked me not to move** her pictures.

items: We can also use **whether** instead of **if** in reported questions.
He asked her **whether** she had been to the gallery.

blocks.text: Remember not to use question word order in reported questions.

blocks.correct: I asked when they **would finish** the house.
blocks.incorrect: I asked when **would they finish** the house.

items.prompt: 'Has your brother gone out?' Mum asked me. Mum asked me if my brother ___ out.
'Do you know the answer?' Miss Smith asked Ruby. Miss Smith asked Ruby if she ___ the answer.
'Is this your car?' the police officer said to the man. The police officer asked the man if it ___ his car.
'Have you been to see the exhibition?' I asked Benjamin. I asked Benjamin if he ___ to see the exhibition.
'Does your laptop need a new battery?' Jerry asked me. Jerry asked me if my laptop ___ a new battery.
'Are you having a barbecue?' I asked the Browns. I asked the Browns if they ___ a barbecue.

exercises.title: B · One word in each gap
exercises.instruction: Write one word in each gap.

items.prompt: 'Will you be at the party?' Richard asked me. Richard asked me if I ___ be at the party.
'May I ask you a few questions?' the woman asked Ted. The woman asked Ted if she ___ ask him a few questions.
'Can we go to the zoo tomorrow?' Jane asked her father. Jane asked her father if they ___ go to the zoo the following day.
'Shall I study maths or English?' Sally asked her best friend. Sally asked her best friend whether she ___ study maths or English.
'Can you write with your left hand?' Val asked me. Val asked me whether I ___ write with my left hand.
'Shall we play tennis or volleyball?' Debbie asked her sister. Debbie asked her sister if they ___ play tennis or volleyball.
'May I leave the table?' Samantha asked her parents. Samantha asked her parents if she ___ leave the table.
'Will our bus leave on time?' Mum asked the driver. Mum asked the driver whether our bus ___ leave on time.

exercises.title: C · Similar meaning
exercises.instruction: Complete each second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence. Write between two and five words.

items.prompt:
'When did your brother join the army?' Rudy asked me.
Rudy asked me ___ the army.
acceptedAnswers: Rudy asked me when my brother had joined the army.
Rudy asked me when my brother had joined the army

exercises.title: D · Picture orders
exercises.instruction: Look at the pictures and complete the sentences.

items.prompt:
A mum points at a messy room and says 'Tidy your room!'
My mum told ___ .
acceptedAnswers: My mum told me to tidy my room.
My mum told me to tidy my room

exercises.title: F · Tick or correct
exercises.instruction: If the word or phrase in bold is correct, write it again. If it is wrong, write the correct word or phrase.

items.prompt: I asked Toni why **had she taken** my CD without asking me.
Roger told Isabelle **don't make** any plans for the weekend.
Madison asked me how much my new jeans **had cost**.
Alexander asked his dad **giving** him some money for his school trip.
I told Jeremy **you don't move** while I took his photograph.
Annie told her dog **to sit**, but it didn't.
